# The Myth of the Lone Fashion Genius — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-157996
Voiceover: A less-remembered house remains researchable because its object record survives.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Marion Litchfield, 1950

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CA10-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · SIGNATURE — Why does one name dominate?. A single name gives press, commerce, and memory a compact handle. It can truthfully identify creative authority while still concealing the distributed labor required to materialize that authority.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA10-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · CONSTELLATION — Who translated the idea?. Build a role map from concept to archive. Record not only names but decisions: who interpreted proportion, solved construction, negotiated feasibility, shaped the image, and preserved the evidence.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA10-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · CREDIT — What should the record retain?. Credits should travel with garments, images, video, collection notes, and archival deposits. The durable record needs consistent role language and a correction path when work is omitted or misdescribed.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA10-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · POWER — Does visibility follow value?. Credit cannot by itself repair inequitable pay, ownership, or authority. It does, however, make labor and decision structures more legible—creating evidence for harder questions about compensation and control.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
